'''Daniel Amor''' (GEMP handle '''Heisenberg''')<ref name="roster">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]]; [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit Google Sheet]; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing 8 October 2026]</ref> finished '''#2''' at the [[2026 San Diego Super Open]] and 2nd at the [[2023 San Diego Super Open]]<ref name="sdso-wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/drew-lichtenstein-wins-the-san-diego-super-open-schoenthal-inducted-to-pc-hall-of-fame/ Drew Lichtenstein Wins the San Diego Super Open; Schoenthal inducted to PC Hall of Fame], starwarsccg.org (25 January 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022211618/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/drew-lichtenstein-wins-the-san-diego-super-open-schoenthal-inducted-to-pc-hall-of-fame.html Internet Archive]</ref>. Amor also finished '''#19''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 32; Challonge seed 11).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
